title: RecommendationSystem RecSysV2LaunchEvaluation

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the RecSys v2 launch evaluation research task. Generated comprehensive analysis including: 1) Loaded and analyzed offline evaluation metrics (n=200,000) and online A/B test data (14-day, 10% traffic), 2) Created three detailed visualizations (offline comparison, online A/B test, trade-off analysis) saved as PNG files, 3) Implemented weighted decision matrix analysis, 4) Produced a complete research report (report.md) with methodology, results, interpretation, and clear recommendation. Final recommendation: DO NOT LAUNCH RecSys v2 due to critical regressions in complaint rate (+187.0%) and catalog coverage (-50.6%) outweighing positive gains in CTR and ranking precision.
